configs.label: Notes BM25
configs.description: Searches only Granola titles, lists, attendees, and generated notes. This is cheap and fast, but misses details only present in raw transcript.
configs.promptPolicy: Strict extractive answer with meeting-id citations and explicit uncertainty.
configs.orchestrationPolicy: Single retrieval pass over notes, then deterministic grounded synthesis.
configs.contextPolicy: Notes-only context, one document per meeting, small context budget.
configs.toolPolicy: Local BM25 retrieval only; no network or model dependency.

configs.label: Compact Hybrid BM25
configs.description: Searches notes and transcripts but keeps a tight, diversified context window. This tests whether a compact agent loop can stay grounded without flooding the model/context.
configs.promptPolicy: Strict extractive answer with short evidence snippets and meeting-id citations.
configs.orchestrationPolicy: Single retrieval pass with aggressive meeting diversification before synthesis.
configs.contextPolicy: Hybrid notes/transcript context, top 6 results, one chunk per meeting, 7k character budget.
configs.toolPolicy: Local BM25 retrieval over notes plus transcript chunks.

configs.label: Hybrid Transcript BM25
configs.description: Searches metadata/notes plus overlapping transcript chunks, then packs diversified evidence into the answer context.
configs.promptPolicy: Strict extractive answer with meeting-id citations and explicit uncertainty.
configs.orchestrationPolicy: Single retrieval pass over notes and transcript chunks, then deterministic grounded synthesis.
configs.contextPolicy: Balanced hybrid context, top 12 results, up to two chunks per meeting, 14k character budget.
configs.toolPolicy: Local BM25 retrieval over notes plus transcript chunks.

configs.label: Wide Context Hybrid BM25
configs.description: Gives the agent a larger transcript window and allows more chunks per meeting. This tests recall gains against longer context, more tokens, and more citation noise.
configs.promptPolicy: Strict extractive answer, but with broader evidence available for multi-meeting synthesis.
configs.orchestrationPolicy: Single retrieval pass with a high-recall context packer.
configs.contextPolicy: Wide hybrid context, top 18 results, up to three chunks per meeting, 24k character budget.
configs.toolPolicy: Local BM25 retrieval over notes plus transcript chunks.

configs.label: Recency Weighted Hybrid BM25
configs.description: Uses the same local tools as the balanced hybrid harness, but increases recency weighting for latest/current-style questions.
configs.promptPolicy: Strict extractive answer with meeting-id citations and explicit uncertainty.
configs.orchestrationPolicy: Temporal-aware retrieval pass that boosts newer meetings when the query asks for latest/current state.
configs.contextPolicy: Balanced hybrid context with stronger temporal ranking and a 14k character budget.
configs.toolPolicy: Local BM25 retrieval over notes plus transcript chunks with temporal metadata boost.

configs.label: Vector DB + BM25 RAG
configs.description: Indexes notes and transcript chunks into a local vector database, fuses cosine similarity with BM25 candidates, and answers with the same deterministic grounded synthesizer.
configs.promptPolicy: Strict extractive answer with meeting-id citations and explicit uncertainty.
configs.orchestrationPolicy: Hybrid retrieval pass that fuses local vector database search with BM25, then deterministic grounded synthesis.
configs.contextPolicy: Hybrid notes/transcript vector index, top 12 results, up to two chunks per meeting, 14k character budget.
configs.toolPolicy: Local vector database retrieval plus BM25 candidate fusion; no external vector service required.
